text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right! Horseshoes are good. Laces swapped! 
All the mud is wiped off, squeaky clean~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Kita-chan's been diligently 
maintaining her shoes every day lately.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! 'Cause I wanna be in top shape for 
tomorrow's training!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And then I'll show Trainer how much I've 
grown and surprise them! They'll say, 
'You've got way more stamina than last 
week!!'

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer is always so quick to find my good 
points and give me lots of praise.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...I was thinking maybe you'd give me 
lots of 'good jobs' again this time. 
Ehehe."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I seeee. So for Kita-chan, practice is 
also a place to show off the results of 
your daily efforts to Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll be in your care for today's 
training too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"And take a look and be amazed! Look at 
how much I've grown under your guidance!"

After her energetic declaration, Kitasan 
Black showed an even better run than 
yesterday.
